summary: Iteration 9 — new PSB + MULTIGANGGUAN ticket types (additive, no breakage of GANGGUAN flow). Backend: 9/9 pytest PASS covering (a) GANGGUAN regression (default ticket_type, full lifecycle MASUK→DIPROSES→SELESAI with completion evidence), (b) PSB create persists ticket_type/psb_service_type/psb_package/psb_install_address + full lifecycle to SELESAI, (c) MULTIGANGGUAN create with affected_customers[] auto-generating id + status='Down' + restored_at=null, (d) MG resolve gating: HTTP 400 while any Down (message mentions Restored & X/Y ratio) then 200 SELESAI after all Restored, (e) POST /affected add + DELETE /affected/{id} remove + PATCH /affected/{id} restore work and are reflected, (f) GET /crm/tickets?ticket_type=PSB|MULTIGANGGUAN|GANGGUAN filters — GANGGUAN also includes legacy tickets w/o field, (g) closing_resume message contains '🏷 Jenis:' line with 'PSB' / 'Multigangguan' label, (h) public GET /api/track/{token} payload includes 'ticket_type'. Frontend Playwright: login, /crm/open shows open-ticket-type selector with 3 buttons (GANGGUAN/PSB/MULTIGANGGUAN), selecting PSB reveals open-psb-fields (open-psb-service Broadband FTTH + open-psb-package + open-psb-address), selecting MULTIGANGGUAN reveals open-mg-fields (open-mg-cause + AffectedEditor mg-add-customer-manual/mg-add-customer-btn adds rows to mg-affected-list; mg-add-customer-picker opens DB customer combobox with pre-seeded customers). Created 1 PSB + 1 MG ticket end-to-end via UI, both reached the success screen 'Ticket berhasil dibuat'. PSB detail page shows 'Detail PSB (Aktivasi Pelanggan Baru)' card + ticket-type-PSB header badge. MG detail page shows detail-affected-list/detail-affected-progress/detail-affected-input/detail-affected-add + row-level restore/remove buttons + ticket-type-MULTIGANGGUAN header badge. Ticket Masuk masuk-filter-type has Semua/Gangguan/PSB/Multigangguan options; filtering PSB yields only PSB badges (2), Multigangguan yields only MG badges (2). Diproses/Selesai filter-type present. All UI-created tickets removed from Mongo at the end.
critical_code_review_comments: crm_helpdesk.py grew to ~1195 lines; consider splitting into modules (tickets_crud.py, resolve.py, affected.py, files.py) — approaching the 700-line guideline.

In list_tickets ticket_type filter, GANGGUAN branch appends `{$or: [ticket_type=GANGGUAN, not-exists, null]}` to `query['$and']`. If other filters also want to use $and, ensure array is initialized once. Currently working, but future filters that also push $and must not overwrite it.
AffectedCustomerIn accepts arbitrary customer_name (no length/whitespace validation). Consider min_length=1 to prevent creating affected rows with empty names via the API.
resolve_ticket MULTIGANGGUAN gate check happens BEFORE completion evidence check — good UX, since fixing the affected list is cheaper than uploading a photo just to see another 400.
seed_data_creation: Backend test created 3 tickets (1 GANGGUAN regression, 1 PSB, 1 MG) — deleted in test_zzz_cleanup_mongo. Frontend Playwright created 1 PSB + 1 MG ticket — deleted from Mongo via ad-hoc cleanup after the run. DB left clean. notification_settings left enabled+send_closing_resume=true per user request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter9 verified additive feature. Legacy tickets (no ticket_type field) behave as GANGGUAN in list filter and default ticket_type='GANGGUAN' is stored on new tickets. Fields to remember: TicketCreate accepts ticket_type + psb_service_type/psb_package/psb_install_address (PSB) + mg_cause/affected_customers[{customer_name, customer_id?, status='Down'|'Restored', note}] (MG). Endpoints: POST /api/crm/tickets/{tid}/affected {customer_name}, PATCH /api/crm/tickets/{tid}/affected/{acid} {status}, DELETE /api/crm/tickets/{tid}/affected/{acid} — all require ticket_type='MULTIGANGGUAN' else 400. resolve_ticket returns 400 if any affected is not 'Restored' with detail 'Semua pelanggan terdampak harus berstatus Restored dulu (X/Y restored).'. closing_resume message now includes line '🏷 Jenis: {ticket_type_label}' where label map is {GANGGUAN:'Gangguan',PSB:'PSB (Aktivasi Baru)',MULTIGANGGUAN:'Multigangguan'}. Public /api/track/{token} JSON includes 'ticket_type'. Frontend testids: open-ticket-type + open-ticket-type-{GANGGUAN|PSB|MULTIGANGGUAN}; open-psb-fields (open-psb-service/package/address); open-mg-fields (open-mg-cause) + AffectedEditor (mg-add-customer-picker, mg-add-customer-manual, mg-add-customer-btn, mg-affected-list, mg-affected-{i}, mg-affected-remove-{i}); TicketDetail: ticket-type-{TYPE} header badge, PsbCard with title 'Detail PSB (Aktivasi Pelanggan Baru)', AffectedPanel with detail-affected-list/detail-affected-progress/detail-affected-input/detail-affected-add + per-row detail-affected-down-{i}/detail-affected-restore-{i}/detail-affected-remove-{i} (Set Down button only shown when status='Restored', Restore button only when 'Down'). Filter testids: masuk-filter-type, diproses-filter-type, selesai-filter-type with options 'Semua Jenis' + labels from TICKET_TYPE_LABEL.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found; additive feature end-to-end works as designed.
